candidates.comment: I don't know that I can for sure fix what is going on since things that happen when you are already in flight tend to be wayyyy more complicated but let me give you some places to start checking!   Since it isn't freaking out right off the line, we know it can't be prop direction, motor direction, board alignment, or any of the other things from this video.  All of those would cause an immediate issue.  Usually when you are in flight and start getting run aways, it is due to vibration feedback in the gyro and over-compensation by the flight controller.  That could be caused by mechanical issues with your quad, like cracks in the frame, delamination on arms or plates, missing screws, a tightly mounted stack, lots of things.  I would start checking there first.  If that doesn't turn up anything, then there is likely an issue with your tune or filtering so I would roll back any changes you might have made to it or somehow get back to either betaflight defaults or whatever the manufacturer shipped it with if it was a bind and fly.  Im sorry I can't just tell you exactly what the issue is, but I hope some of this helps you track it down!

candidates.comment: I don't know that I can for sure fix what is going on since things that happen when you are already in flight tend to be wayyyy more complicated but let me give you some places to start checking!   Since it isn't freaking out right off the line, we know it can't be prop direction, motor direction, board alignment, or any of the other things from this video.  All of those would cause an immediate issue.  Usually when you are in flight and start getting run aways, it is due to vibration feedback in the gyro and over-compensation by the flight controller.  That could be caused by mechanical issues with your quad, like cracks in the frame, delamination on arms or plates, missing screws, a tightly mounted stack, lots of things.  I would start checking there first.  If that doesn't turn up anything, then there is likely an issue with your tune or filtering so I would roll back any changes you might have made to it or somehow get back to either betaflight defaults or whatever the manufacturer shipped it with if it was a bind and fly.  Im sorry I can't just tell you exactly what the issue is, but I hope some of this helps you track it down!
